Bone and Beyondd Brand Guide

Brand message

Advanced Orthopaedic Care with Precision. Use plain language about joints, sport and everyday movement. Give visitors a clear next step with Book Consultation.

Colour palette

Navy
#081D43
Action blue
#0759CF
Ice blue
#EEF5FF
White
#FFFFFF

Use navy and blue for the logo and clinic materials. The reference-matched website pairs white and warm gold with green for WhatsApp controls.

Typography and logo

Use Inter when available, with the device’s system sans-serif as the website fallback. Use bold headings, medium-weight navigation and regular-weight body text. Use the full logo on white in the header and clinic materials. Use the cropped motion mark for the favicon or large background artwork. Keep its proportions and avoid placing it over busy photos.

Launch plan

  1. Verify clinic details. Confirm the official phone, WhatsApp, email, address, hours, map pin, doctor portrait and credentials. Have the clinic review the care topics and patient-facing copy.
  2. Connect booking. Replace preview mode with the clinic’s preferred booking system or WhatsApp workflow. Define how the clinic confirms a requested date and handles requests.
  3. Test and publish. Verify calls, WhatsApp, directions and booking delivery on mobile and desktop. Add approved clinic metadata, connect the public domain and enable indexing when ready.
